description: This file contains unit tests for the ReportingMethodConfigurationDao class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It tests CRUD operations, existence checks, and fetching methods related to ReportingMethod entities.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ReportingMethodConfigurationDao, verifying CRUD operations and other data interactions for ReportingMethod entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creates an instance of the DAO, and populates test data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testAddReportingMethod
methods.description: Verifies that a new ReportingMethod can be added and correctly persisted.

methods.name: testEditReportingMethod
methods.description: Checks that an existing ReportingMethod can be fetched and updated.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a ReportingMethod by its ID.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodList
methods.description: Verifies that a list of ReportingMethod entities can be fetched based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodListWithLimit
methods.description: Tests list retrieval with a limit parameter.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Checks that the count of ReportingMethods is correctly returned.

methods.name: testDeleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Verifies that reporting methods can be deleted by IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Ensures that deleting non-existing records results in zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks case insensitivity and whitespace trimming when verifying if a ReportingMethod name exists.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of ReportingMethod by name, verifying case insensitivity and whitespace trimming.
